subject: measure of inbreeding calculated using gl.grm

messages.author: 9bab4c98a6acda91
messages.subject: measure of inbreeding calculated using gl.grm
parts:
Hi Arthur,

I was wondering if the measure of inbreeding given along the diagonal when using the gl.grm function is the same as the g2 values that several other packages e.g. InbreedR produce?

Cheers,
Shandiya

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: measure of inbreeding calculated using gl.grm
parts:
Hi Shandiya,

Our script is a wrapper for A.mat function in the BLUP package and the references therein. The diagonal is a measure of inbreeding, but whether it is the same as that calculated in InbreedR I am not sure. You would need to run the two on the same dataset and see if they give the same answers, and check the literature describing both approaches.

A
